settings.customCharacterStyle: Exact canonical brothers from CHARACTER_SHEETS. Never alter faces, skin, hair, outfits, props, age or height relationship.
settings.customProjectStructure: 16 continuous final-obstacle scenes. Checkpoints, moving platforms, key tokens, doors and final portal persist. Scene N+1 starts from Scene N end frame. One speaker maximum.

movie.storyTitle: Roblox Brothers Adventure EP10 — Mega Obby Final
movie.storySummary: สองพี่น้องเข้าสู่ Mega Obby รอบสุดท้าย ต้องผ่านแพลตฟอร์มเร็ว กำแพงเลเซอร์แบบปลอดภัย สะพานหมุน เก็บโทเคนสองชิ้น เปิดประตูสุดท้าย และขึ้นหอคอย Finish เพื่อกลับบ้านพร้อมปิดซีซัน
movie.mainStoryPrompt: One continuous final adventure. Exact brother identities fixed. Every checkpoint, token, platform, door and portal state persists and cannot reset. End with a complete payoff and both brothers together.

scenes.title: Mega Obby
scenes.continuityStartState: Canonical brothers arrive together at final lobby; giant obstacle route visible ahead; two empty token sockets beside final gate in distance.
scenes.mainAction: older brother looks over entire route and gives younger brother a confident nod

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: ด่านสุดท้ายแล้ว

scenes.imageDescription: HARD IDENTITY LOCK. Same canonical brothers, older visibly taller, final obstacle world ahead, no readable UI.
scenes.videoPrompt: Character Sheets primary. Wide reveal then settle on brothers. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Brothers stand at first platform edge; younger front-right ready to jump; older one step behind-left.

scenes.title: แพลตฟอร์มเร็ว
scenes.continuityStartState: Younger ready at first edge, older behind; moving platforms cycle ahead.
scenes.mainAction: younger waits for nearest platform and jumps first
scenes.imageDescription: Same moving-platform cycle; younger jumps first, older remains on start edge.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low side view showing takeoff and landing. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Younger stands on first moving platform; older still at start, next platform aligns between them.

scenes.title: พี่ตามมา
scenes.continuityStartState: Younger on first moving platform; older at start; next alignment visible.
scenes.mainAction: older jumps to same platform as it aligns
scenes.imageDescription: Previous scene + Character Sheets. Same platform and positions; older joins younger, no duplicate.
scenes.videoPrompt: Three-quarter follow of older jump. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Both stand together on moving platform; checkpoint platform approaches ahead.

scenes.title: เช็กพอยต์หนึ่ง
scenes.continuityStartState: Both on moving platform approaching checkpoint one.

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: เช็กพอยต์แรก

scenes.imageDescription: Same brothers step from moving platform onto checkpoint; platform continues away behind.
scenes.videoPrompt: Side transfer shot. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Both on activated checkpoint one; fast platforms behind; laser timing corridor ahead.

scenes.title: กำแพงเลเซอร์
scenes.continuityStartState: Checkpoint one active behind; brothers at corridor entrance.
scenes.mainAction: older brother watches safe gaps in harmless light barriers

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: รอช่องว่างก่อน

scenes.imageDescription: Same brothers at entrance; bright harmless light barriers cycling, no injury or text.
scenes.videoPrompt: Static timing shot. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: A safe gap opens; younger ready first, older beside him; checkpoint one remains active behind.

scenes.title: ผ่านช่องแสง
scenes.continuityStartState: Safe gap open; both ready at corridor entrance.
scenes.mainAction: they run through one open gap to far safe zone
scenes.imageDescription: Same light-barrier state at start; brothers cross together without teleporting.
scenes.videoPrompt: Rear tracking run. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Both reach far safe zone; light barriers continue behind; rotating bridge ahead.

scenes.title: สะพานหมุน
scenes.continuityStartState: Brothers at rotating-bridge entrance; bridge turning slowly.
scenes.mainAction: younger brother watches one full rotation and identifies flat moment

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: ตอนมันตรงค่อยไป

scenes.imageDescription: Same bridge rotating; brothers observe, no crossing yet.
scenes.videoPrompt: Wide side shot showing full rotation timing. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Bridge aligns flat; younger steps onto first section; older immediately behind.

scenes.title: ข้ามสะพานหมุน
scenes.continuityStartState: Bridge aligned flat; younger on first section, older behind.

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: ไปต่อเนื่องเลย

scenes.imageDescription: Same bridge and order; younger leads, older follows; no reset mid-crossing.
scenes.videoPrompt: Low rear follow across bridge. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Both reach far platform; rotating bridge behind; first token pedestal directly ahead.

scenes.title: โทเคนแรก
scenes.continuityStartState: Both on far platform; first token on pedestal.
scenes.mainAction: older brother picks up first plain token

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: ได้หนึ่งชิ้น

scenes.imageDescription: Same platform. Older picks one token; pedestal becomes empty.
scenes.videoPrompt: Medium pickup. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Older carries token one; younger points toward bounce pads leading upward.

scenes.title: เด้งขึ้นชั้นบน
scenes.continuityStartState: Older carries token one; bounce pads ahead.
scenes.mainAction: younger uses first bounce pad and lands on upper ledge; older waits below

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: ผมขึ้นก่อน

scenes.imageDescription: Same token remains with older below; younger lands on upper ledge, no duplicate.
scenes.videoPrompt: Side angle showing full launch and landing. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Younger on upper ledge; older below with token one; second pad ready for older.

scenes.title: ขึ้นพร้อมกันอีกครั้ง
scenes.continuityStartState: Younger on upper ledge; older below carrying token one.
scenes.mainAction: older uses second pad and lands beside younger
scenes.imageDescription: Older lands with same token one still carried; younger waits at ledge edge.
scenes.videoPrompt: Three-quarter follow of older ascent. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Both together on upper ledge; token one with older; second token visible through short tunnel ahead.

scenes.title: โทเคนสอง
scenes.continuityStartState: Both on upper ledge; token one with older; token two ahead.
scenes.mainAction: younger reaches token two and picks it up

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: ครบสองแล้ว

scenes.imageDescription: Younger picks exactly one second token; older still carries first. Pedestal empties.
scenes.videoPrompt: Medium two-shot showing two separate tokens. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Older holds token one, younger holds token two; final gate with two empty sockets visible ahead.

scenes.title: เปิดประตูสุดท้าย
scenes.continuityStartState: Both before final gate; older holds token one, younger token two; two sockets empty.

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: พร้อมนะ ใส่เลย

scenes.imageDescription: Each token moves from correct brother hand into one socket; hands become empty; gate begins opening.
scenes.videoPrompt: Front medium shot across both sockets. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Both tokens locked in sockets; final gate fully open; finish tower staircase beyond.

scenes.title: ขึ้น Finish Tower
scenes.continuityStartState: Final gate open with both tokens installed; staircase ahead.
scenes.mainAction: brothers climb tower together side-by-side where possible

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: ด่านสุดท้ายจริงๆ

scenes.imageDescription: Same open gate and tokens remain behind. Brothers climb one continuous staircase, exact identities fixed.
scenes.videoPrompt: Rear upward follow. Only younger brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Both reach finish platform; large return portal inactive until final floor pad is stepped on.

scenes.title: Finish Pad
scenes.continuityStartState: Both on finish platform; return portal inactive; one glowing floor pad between them and portal.
scenes.mainAction: both step onto finish pad together and portal activates

dialogues.speaker: C-SHARP
dialogues.text: เราผ่านครบแล้ว

scenes.imageDescription: Same brothers step together; one finish pad glows and one portal activates, no text/UI.
scenes.videoPrompt: Wide two-shot with portal lighting behind. Only older brother speaks.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Return portal fully open; brothers stand shoulder-to-shoulder facing it; completed tower behind.

scenes.title: จบการผจญภัย
scenes.continuityStartState: Both shoulder-to-shoulder facing open final portal.
scenes.mainAction: they enter together and emerge in familiar home lobby, then exchange a proud smile

dialogues.speaker: ARI
dialogues.text: ครั้งหน้าลุยด้วยกันอีกนะ

scenes.imageDescription: Use Character Sheets + previous scene. Same brothers enter together, then emerge in familiar bright lobby with exact outfits/props unchanged. No readable text.
scenes.videoPrompt: Follow into portal then soft match transition to lobby. Only younger brother speaks after arrival.
scenes.continuityEndFrame: Both brothers stand together safely in home lobby, same canonical identities intact, season adventure complete.
